# Data

**All data in this folder is synthetic.** It was generated by `scripts/prepare_dataset.py`
(seed 42) for educational use and does not describe real customers.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `raw_transactions.csv` | Raw long-format invoice lines with deliberate quality problems (duplicates, missing values, inconsistent names, non-product lines). Columns: `transaction_id, item, category, quantity, transaction_date, cashier_id`. |
| `transactions.csv` | Cleaned dataset: one row per distinct `(transaction_id, item)`. This is what gets mined. |
| `manual_rule_review.csv` | Hand-written classification and reasoning for 13 discovered rules. Contains no metrics; support and confidence are looked up from the mined rules at run time. |

## Why synthetic?

We looked for a public automotive spare-parts dataset with invoice-level baskets (retrieved 9 October 2026):

- *Spare Parts Time Series Indian Dataset*, IEEE DataPort —
  <https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/spare-parts-time-series-indian-dataset>.
  Listed schema: `job_card_date, invoice_line_text, material, supplier_name, review_text`
  (28,459 records). Not used: access requires an IEEE DataPort subscription, the listed schema has
  no invoice/transaction identifier, and the page states no licence.
- General retail basket datasets (groceries, online retail) contain no automotive products.

No usable source was found, so the assignment's requirements are demonstrated on generated data.

## How the generator works (`src/synthetic_data.py`)

1. Each basket is drawn from one of 12 *purchase occasions* (oil service, brake job, tune-up,
   battery, cooling, visibility, detailing, tyres, suspension, road trip, lighting, transmission).
2. Every occasion lists parts with an inclusion probability (e.g. oil service: Engine Oil 0.95,
   Oil Filter 0.85, Air Filter 0.45).
3. 25% of baskets combine two occasions; every basket gets Poisson(0.4) unrelated "noise" items.
4. The raw file is then degraded: ~3% of names are re-formatted (`ENGINE OIL`, `engine_oil`, extra
   spaces), ~6% of invoices get a non-product line (Labour Charge / Service Fee / Discount), 12
   invoices contain only a labour charge, 0.5% of item names and 0.3% of transaction IDs are
   blanked, and 2% of rows are duplicated.

**Every rule the system discovers is a consequence of these probabilities.**

## Regenerate

```
python scripts/prepare_dataset.py            # default: 3000 transactions, seed 42
python scripts/prepare_dataset.py --transactions 5000 --seed 7
```

If `raw_transactions.csv` is missing or invalid, the app regenerates the same data in memory
and says so on the Overview page.

## Using your own data

Replace `raw_transactions.csv` with any CSV that has at least `transaction_id` and `item`
columns. Then update the provenance text in `src/data_loader.py`, which currently labels the file
as synthetic.
